description: Canal-belt cornice house of the 18th c. with a raised crest (Keizersgracht 254): a 5.6 m front of smooth cream-painted render, a tall ground storey of house door and small-paned windows at street level and three upper storeys of three axes of small-paned windows (three lights across) in white frames, under a straight white cornice carrying a raised semicircular crest with a cartouche over the middle

match.note: Keizersgracht 254 (169444), 2021-01-22 strip gridded at 2x (grid-crop 1815-2285): ground windows 2.0-4.7 m, rows 5.6-8.1, 8.84-10.45, 11.2-12.5 m, cornice 13.4-14.0 m, crest 14.0-15.3 m about 3.5 m wide; pinned per pand (review-types)

crest.note: Keizersgracht 254: a raised semicircular crest about 3.5 m wide standing 1.3 m on the cornice (14.0-15.3 m), a cartouche in its face

roof.evidence: Keizersgracht 254 (2021-01-22 strip): sky over the cornice and crest from the quay; no roof face shows
